_comment: The fleet's blessed MAJOR version per key package — the SSOT the
version-currency audit measures every repo against. Raise a number here
(in a PR) when the fleet decides a new major is the standard; the audit
then reports every repo below it as a gap. Majors only: 0.x packages
(drizzle-orm, @anthropic-ai/sdk) have no meaningful major and are not
listed. THAT EXEMPTION USED TO NAME @bitbaum/ai-kit AND OUTLIVED IT: the
package graduated to npm at 0.x, so its internal_tags entry was deleted
per the rule below and it was never added here -- and then it shipped
1.0.0 and nothing noticed, because the comment explaining its absence
still described it as 0.x. Seven of thirteen consumers sat on 0.x carets
(^0.15.0 pins the MINOR) while the package was at 1.4.1, and no gate said
so. A version-tracking exemption must be re-read when the version moves.
next-auth is deliberately absent while v5 is
beta — which is exactly why it stopped being the blessed auth library on
2026-09-11: a choice this audit cannot measure is a choice that drifts.
